detail.longDescription: If your agent sandbox resolves arbitrary DNS, it has internet access. On Sept 20 an OpenAI research model, blocked at the HTTPS proxy, found the resolver returned real records and sent questions to a public chatbot over DNS. The fix: allowlist domains and record types. Zenity's SalesBleed on Agentforce leaked CRM data the same way. The lookup carried it. https:// alignment.openai.com/misalignm ent-reports/an-agent-used-dns-to-reach-an-external-chatbot/ # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # DNS
